avis.titre: Works on sun damaged and aging skin, especially together with derma roller
avis.texte: (update Sept 2015: continue to use this and have tried competitor products, it works and I am quite old! but skin looking good!) Reputable dermatologists say there are only a few active ingredients out there that are proven to do anything beneficial for the skin besides moisturize it (which Crisco or vaseline could do too!) , no matter what hype the cosmetic companies put out. One of those is vitamin C. (Caution: don't use a Vit C product at the same time as Retinols (Retin A or OTC Retinol products like Roc etc), or Glycolic acids, or beta acids (salicylic etc). Use the Vit C in the a.m. and the others in the PM, sometimes even that will be too irritating for some skins. At the least put a few hours between applications of acidic products!). I heard about this product first on a skin care forum I belong to, as I am a sort of hobby aesthetician and makeup artist and always looking for something to help my own aging skin. I use a derma roller (many brands and most are about the same, needle size is the key difference), and this product used in concert with it really has helped stimulate collagen (the disappearance which is what causes skin to look 'aged' , when the padding beneath the surface begins to degrade and so the skin hangs like an empty balloon). I have been using it off and on for several months, and also got some for sisters and friends. In everyone's case I have seen an improvement in skin tone, and definitely a subtle 'plumping' effect. It's not a miraculous overn

avis.titre: My Favorite Vitamin C Serum After 15 Years of Trial and ErrorMy Favorite Vitamin C Serum After 15 Years of Trial and Err
avis.texte: I’ve tried a lot of Vitamin C serums over the past 15 years, and this is the one I’ve decided to stick with. In my opinion, it’s the best one I’ve used so far. It contains 20% pure L-ascorbic acid, along with Vitamin E and Ferulic Acid. From what I’ve learned, that combination helps keep the Vitamin C more stable while giving your skin extra antioxidant protection. I’ve been using this serum for about a month now, and I’m honestly very, very happy with it. My skin tone looks more even, my complexion is brighter, and overall my skin just looks healthier. I can’t honestly say that my pigmentation has disappeared. If anything, it may have faded just a little, but not enough for me to confidently claim a dramatic difference. What I can say is that I spend a lot of time in the sun, and I haven’t noticed any new dark spots appearing, which makes me very happy. I’ll keep using it and see how my skin looks after a few more months. Another reason I love using Vitamin C is that it helps protect my skin from premature aging caused by daily sun exposure. That’s why it’s become a non-negotiable part of my skincare routine. One small tip: I keep my serum in the refrigerator to help it stay fresh longer and slow down oxidation. I also included a video so you can see what the color should look like when it’s fresh. It should be clear or a very pale yellow. If it turns dark yellow, orange, or brown, it’s oxidized and it’s time to replace it. Right now, this is the best Vitamin C serum I’ve fo

avis.titre: The definitive vitamin c for the masses
avis.texte: This is best product if you want a stable and high performing l-ascorbic acid serum for the fairest price. Used in combination with a retinoid, azelaic acid, SPF and a good moisturizer you're getting the very best anti-aging routine without breaking the bank on treatments and procedures. This serum can be drying but is never irritating and even after just a couple of uses you get the most radiant glow and even complexion. It's glass skin in one step. Not to mention the antioxidant capacity and collagen renewing benefits. It's just a very capable serum at a fraction of the price of the Skinceuticals and it will be staying in my routine for the long haul.

avis.titre: I refuse to live without itI refuse to live without it
avis.texte: To me, it doesn’t get any better than this. I have tried several other vitamin C products, some cheaper and some a lot more expensive, with a lower percentage of L-ascorbic acid, but for some reason, I love this one the most. It works the best, feels the best (I genuinely enjoy the moment of applying it to my face), has the best packaging, and comes at the best price. It doesn’t irritate my skin, and it stays fresh for a long time. I store it in the refrigerator as soon as it arrives, which I believe helps maintain its freshness. To be honest, I don’t feel the need to try any other brand anymore. It absorbs really well into my skin, and I love that it doesn’t contain any added fragrance. I always notice a difference in my skin when I stop using it. I also love that it comes in an opaque bottle with a pump. For the life of me, I don’t understand why so many other brands still use clear dropper bottles for vitamin C products. Although I keep both my backup bottle and the one I’m currently using in the refrigerator, I always keep a smaller size in my gym bag or take one with me when I travel. I really wish there was a 10 or 15 ml travel-size bottle available. I personally don’t like the pouches. As you can see from the picture, I refuse to live without it!

This is one of my favorite skin care products EVER... my GOAT. I use it almost daily and I have noticed such a huge change in my skin over the last few months since I started using it. My skin definitely has a glow that it didn't have before. I took off one star, not for the quality/effectiveness of the product itself, but for two other reasons: 1. The packaging (the bottle): I have found that when I press down on the pump, for some reason the product leaks out from around the seam of the bottle. I thought it was just a crazy fluke the first time, so I contacted the manufacturer and *amazing customer service incoming* they sent me another bottle, free of charge (with proof of purchase - I had purchased through Amazon). But my second bottle does the same thing, which 😕 wastes the product! 2. The smell. Honestly, I've gotten used to it so it doesn't bother me anymore, but there is definitely a weird smell to this product. Overall- I LOVE this Vitamin C!

avis.titre: I’m on the fence: A+ formula, F for leaky packagingI’m on the fence: A+ formula, F for leaky packaging
avis.texte: I’ve only been using this for around a month, but so far it’s not discolored nor does it have that terrible vitamin C smell like some I’ve used before. I have not had any skin irritation using it daily in the morning. The formula is a very lightweight clear liquid that applies easily and absorbs quickly. There is really only one con, but it’s a big one. The bottle is a complete mess! It leaks somehow and pools around the edge of the cap/bottle and gunks up if you don’t wipe it every time. When you wipe the gunk off, it takes the yellow paint off the bottle. The bottle leaves rings when you set it down and even the cap leaves rings on the counter. The dispenser shoots the liquid into your hand forcefully and it can splash out of your hand if you’re not careful. I’m on the fence about whether I will repurchase because the high percentage of vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid), with ferulic acid and vitamin E seems like the gold standard for a vitamin C serum but the bottle is a leaky mess. The size of the bottle and amount of product for the price is also a bargain compared to other brands with similar formulas. As long as I’m able to use the whole bottle without the leakiness causing the formula to degrade quickly and start to smell, I will probably repurchase.

avis.titre: An effective Vit C serum at a great value!
avis.texte: I’ve purchased this Vitamin C Serum at least a dozen times, and it’s one of the few skincare products I never want to be without. It has earned a permanent place in my daily skincare routine. The serum absorbs quickly, isn’t greasy or sticky, and layers beautifully under moisturizer and sunscreen. I appreciate that it’s fragrance-free and works well with my skin without causing irritation. My complexion looks brighter, more even, and healthier, and my skin feels smoother! What really says the most about this product is that I’ve recommended it to so many friends, and several of them are now loyal users too. If you’re looking for an effective Vitamin C serum at a great value, I highly recommend giving this one a try.

avis.titre: Works, but not the best smell
avis.texte: Good product, not great smell. I do like the effectiveness and that my sensitive skin didn’t react. Will buy again, just need a good moisturizer over it as the smell is off putting to me. Better quality than others that I’ve tried. Like the packaging.

This is a great product Not irritating to me and extremely good value for money I have noticed a difference in my skin since I have used this product I think Timeless is a very reputable company, and I am impressed

This is excellent product and great packaging. The liquid is intact and no oxidation like other similar products. Airlock tip and pump mechanism are the reason why the liquid inside is very well protected.

avis.titre: ottimo prodotto e consigli per la routine di skin care
avis.texte: dopo molte ricerche sono finalmente approdata a questo siero e ne sono molto molto soddisfatta! usavo già sieri alla vitamina C e ultimamente avevo avuto dei buoni risultati con il truth serum di ole henriksen ma non mi era mai capitato di vedere un miglioramento così forte in meno di una settimana. lo uso la sera, come da consigli del fabbricante dopo aver pulito il viso con un detergente verde leggermente esfoliante di una linea verde da supermercato. non asciugo il viso, al massimo ci appoggio sopra l'asciugamano e aspetto che le gocce di acqua non cadano più giù. dunque, dicevo che pulisco il viso aiutandomi con una spazzolina e poi verso 2/3 pompette di siero nel palmo della mano, attenzione, è molto liquido! lo tengo in frigo per farlo durare di più e faccio assorbire il siero con movimenti prima circolari e poi picchiettando, riesco a metterlo anche su occhi e intorno alle labbra ma non so se chi ha una pelle meno abituata alla vitamina c potrebbe fare lo stesso. nel frattempo continuo le mie abluzioni serali, passano circa 10 minuti insomma e poi metto sul viso dell'aloe vera al 99% che tengo sempre in frigo e massaggio fino ad assorbimento anche quella. se ho qualche brufoletto con un dischetto di cotone, e solo nella zona T oppure solo sul brufolo, metto del tea tree oil naturale al 100%, massaggio un pochetto anche quello. se ho la pelle molto stressata e secca metto una noce minuscola di idratante per sigillare tutti gli attivi all'interno della pelle. Alle volte
Frasco de cristal, no tiene aroma, se siente ligera al aplicar. He leído que es muy buena. Ya veré en unas semanas de uso.

avis.titre: Affordable for such good quality vit c serum
avis.texte: I bought this product cause it’s recommended by a Dermatologist. It is 20% Vit C I’ve been using it for a few weeks now and I like it, the consistency is thin liquid unlike other vit c serum with thick consistency. I usually pump some on my palm, dip my finger and apply on my face. It is fast drying. I use it everyday and it lightens acne scars.

avis.titre: Oxidized product. Don't purchase from this page!!
avis.texte: I bought my first bottle of Timeless Vitamin C 20% after watching many reviews saying that this is a great product. Upon receiving it, I noticed a very strong smell and the color of the liquid of dark yellow. I ignored the fact thinking it was normal and finished using the bottle within 3 months. However, few days ago I placed a new order. This time the liquid was clear like water and contained a very mild smell. Immediately I realized that the first order was bad. I reached out to timeless by email. They stated that if the vitamin c looks dark yellow means Oxidized and is no longer effective. Basically, I use a bad product for months without knowing it. On top of that, it looks like this page is not even one of Timeless authorized reseller: Here is what they told me: In answer to your question, we only have one US AMAZON authorized distributor which is ReCommerce. Please check your receipt of purchase to be sure you ordered with ReCommerce to ensure the efficacy and authenticity of your purchase. I will return the new product and purchase only from their official website. Beware of the bad reviews. They are telling the truth.

avis.titre: A Staple in My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I love this stuff! It was recommended to me as part of a skincare routine that includes tretinoin at night, and it has become a staple in my morning routine. I apply it after cleansing and before moisturizer and sunscreen. I'm on my second bottle now and also keep the travel-size packets on hand, which are great for trips. Over time, I've noticed my skin looks smoother, brighter, and more refreshed. It absorbs well, doesn't feel heavy, and layers easily with my other products. Pro tip: store in refrigerator to preserve quality and for a refreshing application. I've been very happy with the results and will continue repurchasing. Highly recommend!

My dermatologist suggested using four or five products, either in the morning or evening, to help reduce dark spots caused by aging and sun damage from my teens, twenties, and thirties. The vitamin C serum "Timeless" appears to be particularly effective at fading these spots. I've noticed a decrease in their darkness within just a week. I recommend this product, but it's a good idea to check online or consult your doctor for proper application instructions. The plastic cap on the glass bottle, however, doesn't fit well, it snaps on but with a very weak "grab," can easily come off. I experienced this firsthand when I was shaking the bottle to mix its ingredients, and holding mostly the cap, the glass bottle slipped out of my hand and shattered in the sink. The company should consider a screw-on or more secure SNAP-ON design cap, as shaking to mix bottle's contents is common. When I contacted Amazon and explained the issue, a helpful assistant listened carefully, asked for a photo of the broken bottle I had already taken, and a new one arrived in just 1 hour and 10 minutes. I am very impressed and grateful... thanks, Amazon.

I have been using the timeless vitamin C for five years now. This should be a staple in every persons anti-aging daily skin care program. Timeless combines 3 key ingredients;L-Ascorbic Acid, Ferulic Acid and Vitamin E for brightening, evening out the skin and collagen boosting to help diminish fine lines. Due to this being a 20% vitamin C, it may not be a great choice for sensitive skin. But if your skin can tolerate it, this serum is one of the best quality and effective vitamin C products on the market, especially for the price point. When I began using vitamin C, I made sure to try a test spot to see how my skin would react. Then I applied every other day, in the morning after washing my face, allowing my skin to adjust. One pump measures out the proper amount of application to the face. Don’t stop there. I use it on my neck, chest and backs of hands where it can help fade those pesky sun/age spots. After consistent use, my skin noticeably improved.

Ordered this after seeing a dermatologist rave about this product! I’ve tried other (much more expensive vitamin C serums) and I can tell you this works as good if not better than those! I apply two small pumps in the morning to my face, it is quick drying and absorbs easily and then I top with a moisturizer and sunscreen. I can already tell a difference after 2 months! My skin definitely has more of a glow and it has evened out my skin texture! I have very sensitive skin and this product has not caused me any irritation. If you are looking for a strong, effective vitamin C serum at an affordable price this is it!!!

avis.titre: Bright Skin in a Bottle — Smells Like Hot Dog Water, Works Like a Charm
avis.texte: Let’s get the obvious out of the way: it’s not winning any fragrance awards. It’s fragrance-free, but the natural scent is giving “warm pennies in a humid sock drawer.” That said? I’ll gladly smell like oxidized sadness for 30 seconds a day if it means I get glowy, even-toned, baby-cheek skin. This stuff is a workhorse: • 20% L-ascorbic acid: the gold standard for fading dark spots, boosting collagen, and making you look like you drink 2L of water a day (even if you don’t) • Vitamin E & ferulic acid: they stabilize the formula and boost effectiveness like the skincare version of backup dancers who actually carry the show • Watery texture: Absorbs fast, layers great under other serums or SPF I have combo skin with both oil slicks and Sahara zones, and it plays nice with all of it. Doesn’t sting, doesn’t pill, and my face actually feels brighter and smoother within a week. Long-term? It’s helping with uneven tone and fine lines. Storage tip: Keep it in the fridge or a dark drawer unless you enjoy sad, orange, oxidized serum. Final Verdict: Smells questionable. Looks basic. Works beautifully. If you care more about results than luxury, this is your girl.

I’ve been using this serum for well over 5 years. Before using this, I was using skinceuticals serum, which at the time was $166 for 1 ounce bottle don’t get me wrong, that serum changed my life and really made a Jurassic change on my skin, however, I did not like how sticky it felt on me. I was watching a YouTube video of a Doctor Who recommended this serum as an alternative to Skin Ceuticals as the ingredients were over 90% similar. I took the shot, and bought it, since it was very affordable I figured why not? Here we are, four years later, and I have not given up the serum. It hydrates, brightens, and makes you look so youthful. I get so many compliments on my skin, I always tell people about this vitamin C serum. I wear a tinted moisturizer over it and it pairs well with all makeup products and other skin care layering products.
Esta vitamina c me gusta mucho me deja la piel luminosa y muy suave

Have been using Vanicream’s vitamin C serum for a year, but due to using estrogen based night cream even with using vitamin C and SPF I got a spot of melasma. This vitamin C serum is highly recommended on Reddit and the cost is very reasonable, so figured I’d give it a chance. Already liking the results. Melasma seems less prominent. Only downside is it does seem to make my day cream + makeup migrate into my eyes toward the end of the day. Worth it if my skin looks better.

avis.titre: Excellent product to add to your daily skin care routine!
avis.texte: After just about a week of use (mornings only), I did notice my skin was brighter and definitely helped even my skin tone. This is a great value, especially since it contains 20% vitamin C. Anything less than 10% is just a waste. Also, the combination of the vitamin C with the E is and excellent paring - two super-antioxidant, and you only need a small amount of product! I am not in love with the scent, but it is better than other Vitamin C serums that I have used in the past. The glass packaging is great as well, reducing plastic waste. I would definitely buy this product again and I will be adding this to my daily skin care routine!

This serum is amazing. I got it just to experiment with vitamin c serum, figured it could potentially cause long-term benefits. It did not disappoint, I didn’t expect the results I got! Since beginning use I’ve gotten compliments on the glow of my skin and noticed a significant improvement in the evenness of my skin tone. I’ve included a before and after pic on just a small patch of skin on my face. Unfortunately I received a half-filled container as it must have spilled on its way to me, but the quality is still amazing and I plan to buy again in the future. The smell isn’t the greatest, but I’ve heard it described as hotdog water with other serums, this one smells like banana to me (so not the worst, not the best smell-wise). Overall I’d consider this a good find!
Lid wasn’t completely on when it arrived and some of the product crystallized around the top. Not sure if it was a return or what, but sad to see product wasted

avis.titre: Fantastic vitamin c serum even for rosacea
avis.texte: Fantastic vitamin C serum. I am actually mad at myself for waiting so long to buy this. Everything I've read said that vitamin c serum would likely irritate my extremely sensitive, dry, rosacea skin. Even my dermatologist told me this. So, I put off buying any for years. I finally decided to try it and it's fabulous! It doesn't irritate my skin and actually seems to be helping my skin heal. I used it every other day the first week and then every day thereafter. I noticed a difference in my skin after two weeks. It's smoother, softer and looks healthier/more radiant. I don't think it's helped the redness, but it definitely hasn't made it any worse. I've been using it now for about two months and am continuing to see improvements. I did separate the serum into two bottles (using a second, dark colored bottle I had for half of the serum) and have stored both bottles in the refrigerator. I haven't seen any signs of oxidation and next time I don't think I'll bother dividing the serum; I just don't think it's necessary. I do use it on my neck and chest as well as my face, so i think I'll use it up before three months anyway (timeless guarantees it for three months). Also, I have ph strips (bought them on Amazon) and test all my liquid cosmetics. This tested between 2 and 3 (see attached photo), so the ph is correct.
This stuff is amazing! It makes my skin so perfectly dewy. Will definitely be buying again

Worth every penny. I used to use Skinceuticals C E with Ferulic L-Ascorbic acid for close to $200 per small bottle, and timeless 20% vitamin C Acid vitamin E is better! You will see a very noticeable improvement in the brightness, vibrancy, and even tone (yes for those with hyper pigmentation like me) within a few days! I highly recommend this product. Note, I refrigerate mine. This is a pure product, and vitamin C likes cool, dry conditions.

avis.titre: Love the results after using this for a week
avis.texte: Love this brand! It has ferulic acid which goes hand in hand with vitamin C. Brightens my skin and moisturizes it. The only issue I have is when you press the top to get the serum out it comes out fast and usually get in my eye. It’s not thick so if you put it on your fingers it comes off. Besides that I love this brand and will continue to use it.

avis.titre: 1 oz of product not 2 oz as listed
avis.texte: Cannot speak to quality, just received today. 28 1ml packets = approx 1 oz of product. Not 2 oz as described. I'm fine with it, considering the price is still good 👍 and I like the convenience of packets. Will update with product review after use.
I always go back to this Vit c. And this time I’m sticking with it. In my opinion it’s one of the best out there. And I’m 56. ❤️

I have ordered this product several times. Today I received my order and I noticed first when I opened the shipping box that the product box was opened at the bottom. I then removed the actual serum bottle and it was smudged with with either dirt or makeup. I will not be using this on my skin and I will not order it again! You just lost a great customer that recommended this product to many. It’s being returned tomorrow! This is 20% ascorbic acid. Ascorbic acid is what you want when using a vitamin C serum to get great results, the other forms are useless imo. If you have sensitive skin Maelove carries a 15% that is also wonderful. I use both, interchangeably. This is lightweight like water. I squirt two pumps in the palm of my hands and quickly apply to face, neck and chest. Do it quickly because it absorbs right away. Once it is no longer clear and turns yellow it’s starting to oxidize. Vitamin C serums should be clear like water in color and this one is! I only use in the morning on a clean face before other products because I use a retinol at night. Wear your sunscreen! It has made a huge difference in my skin. My skin is brighter, pores are very minimized and it fades sun spots with consistent use. I noticed results within the first week and it only gets better each month.
I do have sensitive and acne prone skin. It didn't react at all like other serum.

This is the second time I bought this serum. I really like the consistency, it is kind of liquid so it’s easy to apply on the face and it doesn’t get heavy if you want to apply moisturizer, SPF or make up. It is Great to help build up collagen and this 20% is a great percentage. Highly recommended!

I purchased this serum after reading positive reviews about its ingredients, but the smell was a huge disappointment. It has a strong, pungent odor that I'd describe as nail polish remover. The scent was so off-putting that I couldn't bring myself to use it consistently. I wish I had tested it sooner, but since I threw away the packaging and let some time pass, I can't return it now. If this was thicker and richer feeling (more gel like) it would be my go-to for life. But the thinness really takes away from what is otherwise a winner.

You can definitely see how the older one is still clear and the BRAND NEW one is already oxidized and has a orange color. It should not look like that. They were very helpful though when I contacted them. I just hope the new bottle isn't going to be oxidized. I will keep you posted.

I was worried product would irritate my skin, but it doesnt. It was the perfect addition to my skincare routine. I would definitely buy again. When I first ordered shipping was delayed and order was cancelled. I am not sure why that happened, but glad I finally got it second time I ordered.

Love timeless vit c. It’s not oily at all and a little goes a long way. Super important to protect your skin from the harmful sun. Highly recommend. Would be careful using on neck and chest. I have sensitive skin and it burned me. I can tolerate on my face with no problem.
I loved the texture of this product. Absorbs into the skin really quickly.

Feels good on the skin! But it does smell not great/kind of weird. Kind of like a banana peal? The smell does go away after about 20 minutes though. It also comes out of the bottle really dramatically. So be careful about that.

avis.titre: So far i like it a lot.
avis.texte: I got my shipment 6 days earlier. Was pleasantly surprised. It's still too early to say about big results. I've been using it for only a week. But my skin definitely looks clear and vibrant. I'm 34. It doesn't have a particular scent. All i do is wash my face with organic soap, then apply 4-5 drops of serum, wait 5 min, then apply my moisturizer. No breakouts. Opposite, it cleared it out. Still have a little, but it's more hormonal. In general i would recommend it based on 1 week results.

avis.titre: This Vitamin C Serum Burned My Face
avis.texte: I can't give any stars for this review but you have to choose one. My face turned dark red and felt like it was on fire after applying the Vitamin C serum. I washed my face several times, and iced it, within a minute or two after applying it. Luckily, my face recovered after several hours, but it still feels like my face is sunburned. I don't know what is in my bottle but it's bad or has gone bad. I've never had this happen before while buying through Amazon. This product was Sold by: PATTERN PRODUCTS, and fulfilled through Amazon.

The last two batches of this serum that I have received were a bit off. The first one was clear, but a little cloudy. All of the other bottles I had received had been completely clear. I thought this was just a fluke or difference in batches, and used it anyway. avis.titre: My ride-or-die vitamin C - effective, gentle, and consistently great
avis.texte: This is one of those products I keep coming back to and have repurchased monthly for years. Timeless Vitamin C has been a staple in my routine for a long time, and it is one of the main reasons my skin stays bright and even. The formula is straightforward and effective - 20% L-ascorbic acid with vitamin E and ferulic acid, no fragrance, no unnecessary fillers. The serum texture is very pleasant and lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well under the rest of my morning skincare and sunscreen. I’ve never experienced stinging, irritation, or sensitivity with this, even though my skin can be reactive if a vitamin C formula is poorly done. With consistent use, my skin looks clearer, more even-toned, and overall healthier. It helps keep post-acne marks from lingering and gives a noticeable brightness without feeling harsh or drying. A little goes a long way, and I appreciate that the ingredient list stays focused on proven actives rather than marketing extras. For reference, I have fair skin that is generally normal but leans dry in the winter, with a history of acne. I also use azelaic acid, retinoids, peptides, and hydrating serums in my routine, and this vitamin C plays very nicely with everything. If you’re looking for a no-nonsense, effective vitamin C that actually delivers results, this one has earned its permanent spot in my routine.

avis.titre: If the serum works, why the deceptive marketing?
avis.texte: These “before and after” images are not meaningfully standardized, which makes the results highly suspect. The lighting and exposure are clearly manipulated between photos. In the “after” image, exposure appears raised enough to wash out darker tones and make blacks appear gray. In the “before” image, shadows and contrast appear increased, which exaggerates pigmentation and unevenness. Even the facial expression changes. This is not a trustworthy comparison. The “clinical results” language is not much better. A study of ONLY 21 participants over 28 days is a TINY, short-term data set, and the listing does not clearly identify the third party that conducted the testing, whether there was a control group, or what the actual evaluation criteria were. If the product works, it should be able to stand on honest presentation alone. Consumers deserve better than manipulated imagery and vague “science-backed” claims. This kind of advertising destroys trust.

avis.titre: Packaging is horrible, product is good!
avis.texte: Product overall is good, I feel like it makes my skin brighter after consistent use. 3 stars is for the packaging. I push the pump probably about 100 times before I can get out enough product to use on my face! Sometimes I think maybe it’s the way I’m holding it, but I try tipping it to the side while pumping, holding it straight up, everything. And no matter what, it takes forever to come out. It’s almost like the straw isn’t working or something. The product is still half full, so yes there is enough in there.

While the price from this seller is impressive, the quality is not! Vitamin C serum is both time and temperature sensitive, therefore needs to be well controlled. Ascorbic acid degrades quickly. This product has a 3 month shelf life once opened (and lasts about 3 months with daily use). My new product arrived with only 2 months left before expiration (it arrived Aug 20, 2021 with an exp date of Oct 14, 2021). I would have used it up within 2 months if I could, but it was already oxidized. It should be practically clear when it’s new. The PH balance was 5.5 when I tested it. That’s too high to be effective. I took a chance and ordered a replacement, but sadly it had the same expiration date and was also oxidized. Hopefully these negative reviews will bring awareness about the importance making sure you check the expiration date and color of the serum before using it. You should have at least 3 months left till it expires. This is an amazing product! Since using this product a year ago, my skin has gotten brighter and sun damage and hyper pigmentation less noticeable. I love Timeless 20% Vitamin C + E Ferulic Acid Serum, just not the last 2 batches I received here.
